Anya: Hey @eng-runtime — marketing is finalizing the launch narrative and webinar. We need a small sample pack + method notes for the 'seed cohort' benchmarks we quoted in the deck. Specifically:
- raw payloads for ~20 representative prompts (we'll paste these)
- p50/p95 token latency and tokens generated per prompt
- exact config used (model, quantization, batch settings, warmup ops)
- warm-cache vs cold-start notes and measurement method
Can someone run a short sanity rerun and drop artifacts to s3://redwood-internal/bench/seed-pack/ ? Need by EOD Wed if possible. :pray:

Sam: Quick q — which model variants should we prioritize? tuned release (redwood-1.2-rt) + quantized fallback? And do you want streaming numbers or non-streaming baseline?

Anya: Prioritize tuned redwood-1.2-rt and quantized int8 fallback. Non-streaming baseline for the main table; include a 5-request streaming sample for the demo. Capture both warm and cold startup.

Luis: I can run cold/warm shots. I'll need the prompt list and the desired traffic split. Anything special about tokenization or post-processing we should replicate?

Jess: I'll paste the prompt set below in a minute. Traffic split we want: 60% short (<50 tokens), 30% mid (50-200), 10% long (>200). Please include a README with exact splits and a CSV with columns: prompt_id,prompt_text,model,variant,batch_size,init_latency_ms,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_out.

Sam: Also we'll attach exact runtime config (docker image, env vars), kernel/lib versions, and RNG seed used. Example run snippet for reproducibility:```bash
docker run --gpus all -e MODEL=redwood-1.2-rt -e QUANT=INT8 -e BATCH=1 redwood/runtime:prod-202603 
# run harness: python tools/bench.py --prompts prompts.csv --mode nonstream --warmup 5 --iter 100 --out results.json
```

bench-bot: queued run 2987 for luis — est 35m. status: queued

Luis: starting job 2987 now (1/4). Will run tuned -> quantized -> streaming smoke -> metadata capture. Est finish ~40m. Will upload tar.gz to the S3 path and ping here.

Anya: Two tiny extras — can you capture RPC retry counts and any observed throttling events? Legal asked we call out nondeterministic ops and whether outputs can vary across runs. Also list CUDA/cuBLAS/cuDNN versions.

Sam: We'll log the runtime libs and any op warnings. We'll also include the run seed and note nondeterministic ops in README. If we see >1% variance in top-k responses across reruns, we'll flag it.

Jess: :thumbsup: I'll update the slide annotations to reference the exact S3 artifact and include a one-line provenance blurb.
